cauza: Measured offset of output phase current measurement or difference between output phase U2 and W2 current measurement is too great (the values are updated during current calibration).
remediu: Try performing the current calibration again (select Current measurement calibration at parameter 99.13). If the fault persists, contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Output current has exceeded internal fault limit.
remediu: Check motor load. If the control unit is externally powered, check the setting of parameter95.04Controlboardsupply. Check acceleration times in parameter group23Speedreferenceramp(speed control), 26 Torque reference chain (torque control) or 28 Frequency reference chain (frequency control). Also check parameters 46.1 Speed scaling, 46.2 Frequency scaling and 46.3 Torque scaling. Check motor and motor cable (including phasing and delta/star connection). Check there are no contactors opening and closing in motor cable. Check that the start-up data in parameter group 99 corresponds to the motor rating plate. Check that there are no power factor correction capacitors or surge absorbers in motor cable. Check encoder cable (including phasing). Check the auxiliary code (format XXXY YYZZ). With parallel-connected inverter modules, “Y YY” specifies through which BCU control unit channel the fault was received. “ZZ” indicates the phase that triggered the fault (0: No detailed information available, 1: U-phase, 2: Vphase, 4: W-phase, 3/5/6/7: multiple phases).

cauza: Drive has detected load unbalance typically due to earth fault in motor or motor cable.
remediu: If the control unit is externally powered, check the setting of parameter 95.4 Control board supply. Check there are no power factor correction capacitors or surge absorbers in motor cable. Check for an earth fault in motor or motor cables by measuring the insulation resistances of motor and motor cable. Try running the motor in scalar control mode if allowed. (See parameter 99.4 Motor control mode.) With parallel-connected modules, check the auxiliary code (format XXXY YYZZ). “Y YY” specifies through which BCU control unit channel the fault was received. If no earth fault can be detected, contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Short-circuit in motor cable(s) or motor.
remediu: Check motor and motor cable for cabling errors. If the control unit is externally powered, check the setting of parameter 95.4 Control board supply. Check that parameter 99.10 Motor nominal power has been set correctly. Check there are no power factor correction capacitors or surge absorbers in motor cable. Check the auxiliary code (format XXXY YYZZ). With parallel-connected inverter modules, “Y YY” specifies through which BCU control unit channel the fault was received. “ZZ” indicates the location of the short circuit (0: No detailed information available, 1: Upper branch of U-phase, 2: Lower branch of U-phase, 4: Upper branch of V-phase, 8: Lower branch of V-phase, 10: Upper branch of W-phase, 20: Lower branch of W-phase, other: combinations of the above). Check auxiliary code 40h = DC capacitor short circuit. After correcting the cause of the fault, reboot the control unit (using parameter 96.8 Control board boot) or by cycling power.

cauza: Excessive IGBT junction to case temperature. This fault protects the IGBT(s) and can be activated by a short circuit in the motor cable.
remediu: Check motor cable. Check ambient conditions. Check air flow and fan operation. Check heatsink fins for dust pick-up. Check motor power against drive power.

cauza: AC phase current difference between parallel-connected inverter modules is excessive.
remediu: Check motor cabling. Check there are no power factor correction capacitors or surge absorbers in motor cable. Check the auxiliary code (format XXXY YYZZ). “XXX” specifies the source of the first error (see “YYY”). “YYY” specifies the module through which BCU control unit channel the fault was received (1: Channel 1, 2: Channel 2, 4: Channel 3, 8: Channel 4, ..., 800: Channel 12, other: combinations of the above). “ZZ” indicates the phase (1: U, 2: V, 3: W).

cauza: Total earth leakage of inverter modules is excessive.
remediu: Check there are no power factor correction capacitors or surge absorbers in motor cable. Measure insulation resistances of motor cables and motor. Contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: IGBT supply unit has detected an earth fault.
remediu: Check AC fuses. Check for earth leakages. Check supply cabling. Check power modules. Check there are no power factor correction capacitors or surge absorbers in supply cable. If no earth fault can be detected, contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Parametrization of the speed/torque limitation curve (in the DC voltage reference chain) are inconsistent.
remediu: Check that the speed points of the curve (defined by 29.70...29.79) are in increasing order.

cauza: Intermediate circuit DC voltage is oscillating due to missing input power line phase or blown fuse or unstable control.
remediu: Check input power line fuses. Check for loose power cable connections. Check for input power supply imbalance. Check the control stability and the speed controller settings.

cauza: No acknowledgement received from charge relay.
remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: 1. The drive hardware is supplied from a common DC bus. 2. Incorrect input power and motor cable connection (i.e. input power cable is connected to the motor connection). 3. Drive has detected load unbalance typically due to earth fault in motor or motor cable.
remediu: 1. Switch off the protection in parameter 31.23. 2. Check the power connections. Check the input fuses. 3. Check there are no power factor correction capacitors or surge absorbers in motor cable. Check for an earth fault in motor or motor cables by measuring the insulation resistances of motor and motor cable. Try running the motor in scalar control mode if allowed. (See parameter 99.4 Motor control mode.)

cauza: Excessive intermediate circuit DC voltage.
remediu: Check that overvoltage control is on (parameter 30.30 Overvoltage control). Check that the supply voltage matches the nominal input voltage of the drive. Check the supply line for static or transient overvoltage. Check brake chopper and resistor (if present). Check deceleration time. Use coast-to-stop function (if applicable). Retrofit drive with brake chopper and brake resistor. With parallel-connected modules, check the auxiliary code (format XXXY YYZZ). “Y YY” specifies through which BCU control unit channel the fault was received.

cauza: Intermediate circuit DC voltage is not sufficient because of a missing supply phase, blown fuse or fault in the rectifier bridge.
remediu: Check supply cabling, fuses and switchgear. With parallel-connected modules, check the auxiliary code (format XXXY YYZZ). “Y YY” specifies through which BCU control unit channel the fault was received.

cauza: Automatic restart failed (see section Automatic restart (page 81)).
remediu: Check the condition of the supply (voltage, cabling, fuses, switchgear).

cauza: Difference in DC voltages between parallel-connected inverter modules.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code (format XXXY YYZZ). “XXX” specifies the source of the first error (see “YYY”). “YYY” specifies the module through which BCU control unit channel the fault was received (1: Channel 1, 2: Channel 2, 4: Channel 3, 8: Channel 4, ..., 800: Channel 12).

cauza: Motor circuit fault due to missing motor connection (all three phases are not connected).
remediu: Connect motor cable.

cauza: Autophasing routine (see section Autophasing (page 63)) has failed.
remediu: For more information, check the auxiliary code. Check that the motor ID run has been successfully completed. Clear parameter 98.15 Position offset user. Check the setting of parameter 99.3 Motor type.

aux_codes.cauza: Estimated and measured positions have opposite signs.
aux_codes.remediu: Check the signs of measured and estimated speeds. Reverse encoder cable phasing or edit parameter 99.16. Check that the load torque is not too high for the Turning mode (must be less than 5%).

aux_codes.cauza: Motor is rotating during autophasing.
aux_codes.remediu: Check that the motor is not already rotatingwhentheautophasingroutine starts.

aux_codes.cauza: Too much difference between measured and estimated positions.
aux_codes.remediu: Check that encoder is not slipping. Check parameter 98.15 several times to verify that the autophasing routine gives consistent results. Check the motor model parameters.

aux_codes.cauza: Rotor did not rotate as expected between zero pulses.
aux_codes.remediu: Check that the zero pulses are given correctly.

aux_codes.cauza: Position estimate did not stabilize.
aux_codes.remediu: Check that the selected mode (parameter 21.13) is appropriate for the motor.

aux_codes.cauza: Measured position status information changed.
aux_codes.remediu: Check that parameter 90.41 is not changed to Estimate during the routine.

aux_codes.cauza: General autophasing failure.
aux_codes.remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

aux_codes.cauza: Selected mode not supported.
aux_codes.remediu: Check that the selected mode (parameter 21.13) is supported by the motor type.

aux_codes.cauza: (LV-Synchro) Standstill failure.
aux_codes.remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Input phase loss detected by the IGBT bridge.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code. Check the source of the fault corresponding to the code: 1: Phase A 2: Phase B 4: Phase C 8: Phase cannot be detected Check the AC fuses. Check for input power supply imbalance.

cauza: Calculated motor cable temperature has exceeded warning limit.
remediu: Check the settings of parameters 35.61 and 35.62. Check the dimensioning of the motor cable in regard to required load.

cauza: Drive module temperature is excessive.
remediu: Check ambient temperature. If it exceeds 40 °C (104 °F), ensure that load current does not exceed derated load capacity of drive. See appropriate Hardware manual. Check drive module cooling air flow and fan operation. Check inside of cabinet and heatsink of drive module for dust pick-up. Clean whenever necessary.

cauza: Control board temperature is too high.
remediu: Check proper cooling of the drive. Check the auxiliary cooling fan.

cauza: Estimated drive IGBT temperature is excessive.
remediu: Check ambient conditions. Check air flow and fan operation. Check heatsink fins for dust pick-up. Check motor power against drive power.

cauza: Drive module temperature is excessive.
remediu: Check ambient temperature. If it exceeds 40 °C (104 °F), ensure that load current does not exceed derated load capacity of drive. See appropriate Hardware manual. Check drive module cooling air flow and fan operation. Check inside of cabinet and heatsink of drive module for dust pick-up. Clean whenever necessary.

cauza: Drive IGBT temperature is excessive.
remediu: Check ambient conditions. Check air flow and fan operation. Check heatsink fins for dust pick-up. Check motor power against drive power.

cauza: Power unit module temperature is excessive.
remediu: See A4B0 Excess temperature.

cauza: High temperature difference between the IGBTs of different phases.
remediu: See A4B1 Excess temperature difference (page 600).

cauza: Measured temperature 1 has exceeded fault limit.
remediu: Check the value of parameter 35.2 Measured temperature 1. Check the cooling of the motor (or other equipment whose temperature is being measured). Check the value of parameter 35.12 Temperature 1 fault limit.

cauza: Measuredtemperature2hasexceeded fault limit.
remediu: Check the value of parameter 35.3 Measured temperature 2. Check the cooling of the motor (or other equipment whose temperature is being measured). Check the value of parameter 35.22 Temperature 2 fault limit.

cauza: A thermistor protection module has been activated by parameter 35.30 but cannot be detected.
remediu: Power down the control unit and make sure that the module is properly inserted in the correct slot. The last digit of the auxiliary code identifies the slot.

cauza: The thermistor protection module installed in slot 1 indicates overtemperature.
remediu: Check the cooling of the motor. Check the motor load and drive ratings. Check the wiring of the temperature sensor. Repair wiring if faulty. Measure the resistance of the sensor. Replace sensor if faulty.

cauza: The thermistor protection module installed in slot 2 indicates overtemperature.
remediu: Check the cooling of the motor. Check the motor load and drive ratings. Check the wiring of the temperature sensor. Repair wiring if faulty. Measure the resistance of the sensor. Replace sensor if faulty.

cauza: The thermistor protection module installed in slot 3 indicates overtemperature.
remediu: Check the cooling of the motor. Check the motor load and drive ratings. Check the wiring of the temperature sensor. Repair wiring if faulty. Measure the resistance of the sensor. Replace sensor if faulty.

cauza: Cooling fan feedback missing.
remediu: See A581 Fan.

cauza: An auxiliary cooling fan (connected to the fan connectors on the control unit) is stuck or disconnected.
remediu: See A582 Auxiliary fan not running.

cauza: Safe torque off hardware failure.
remediu: Contact your local ABB representative, quoting the auxiliary code. The code contains location information, especially with parallel-connected inverter modules. When converted into a 32-bit binary number, the bits of the code indicate the following: 31...28: Number of faulty inverter module (0...11 decimal). 1111: STO_ACT states of control unit and inverter modules in conflict 27: STO_ACT state of inverter modules 26: STO_ACT state of control unit 25: STO1 of control unit 24: STO2 of control unit 23...12: STO1 of inverter modules 12...1 (Bits of non-existing modules set to 1) 11...0: STO2 of inverter modules 12...1 (Bits of non-existing modules set to 1)

cauza: Safe torque off function is active, i.e. safety circuit signal(s) connected to connector XSTO is broken during start or run.
remediu: Check safe torque off circuit connections. For more information, see appropriate drive hardware manual and description of parameter 31.22 STO indication run/stop (page 353).

cauza: Power unit memory has cleared.
remediu: Cycle the power to the drive. If the control unit is externally powered, also reboot the control unit (using parameter 96.8 Control board boot) or by cycling its power. If the problem persists, contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: The hardware of the drive does not match the information stored in the memory unit. This may occur eg. after a firmware update or memory unit replacement.
remediu: Cycle the power to the drive. Check the auxiliary code (format 0X0Y). “X” indicates the first faulty PU channel in hexadecimal (1...C) (With a ZCU control unit, “X” can be 1 or 2 but this is irrelevant to the fault). “Y” indicates the auxiliary code category. The auxiliary code categories are as follows: 1 = PU and CU ratings not the same. Rating ID has changed. 2 = Parallel connection rating ID has changed. 3 = PU types not the same in all power units. 4 = Parallel connection rating ID is active in a single power unit setup. 5 = It is not possible to implement the selected rating with the current PUs. 6 = PU rating ID is 0. 7 = Reading PU rating ID or PU type failed on PU connection. 8 = PU not supported (illegal rating ID). 9 = Incompatible module current rating (unit contains a module with too low a current rating). A - Selected parallel rating ID not found from database. With parallel connection faults (BCU control unit), the format of the auxiliary code is 0X0Y.

cauza: Problem with internal temperature measurement of the drive.
remediu: See A5EA Measurement circuit temperature (page 602).

cauza: The way the control unit is powered does not correspond to parameter setting. Communication errors detected between the drive control unit and the power unit.
remediu: Check setting of 95.4 Control board supply. Check the connection between the control unit and the power unit. Check the auxiliary code (format XXXY YYZZ). With parallel-connected modules, “Y YY” specifies the affected BCU control unit channel (0: broadcast). “ZZ” specifies the error source (1: Transmitter side [link error], 2: Transmitter side [no communication], 3: Receiver side [link error], 4: Receiver side [no communication], 5: Transmitter FIFO error [see “XXX”], 6: Module [xINT board] not found, 7: BAMU board not found). “XXX” specifies the transmitter FIFO error code (1: Internal error [invalid call parameter], 2: Internal error [configuration not supported], 3: Transmission buffer full).

cauza: Connection between the drive control unit and the power unit is lost.
remediu: Check the connection between the control unit and the power unit.

cauza: Internal communication error.
remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Measurement circuit fault.
remediu: If the control unit is externally powered, check the setting of parameter 95.4 Control board supply. If the problem persists, contact your local ABB representative, quoting the auxiliary code.

cauza: Power unit power supply failure.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code (format ZZZY YYXX). “YY Y” specifies the affected inverter module (0...C, always 0 for ZCU control units). “XX” specifies the affected power supply (1: Power supply 1, 2: Power supply 2, 3: both supplies).

cauza: Measurement circuit fault.
remediu: Contact your local ABB representative, quoting the auxiliary code.

cauza: Number of connected power modules differs from expected.
remediu: Check setting of 95.31 Parallel type configuration. Cycle the power to the drive. If the control unit is externally powered, also reboot the control unit (using parameter 96.8 Control board boot) or by cycling its power. If the problem persists, contact your local ABB representative.

aux_codes.cauza: BAMU 1 is in the wrong channel.
BAMU 2 is in the wrong channel.
Power unit (xINT) is in the wrong channel.
Too many power units (xINTs).

cauza: Number of inverter modules detected does not match the value of parameter 95.13 Reduced run mode.
remediu: Check that the value of 95.13 Reduced run mode corresponds to the number of inverter modules present. Check that the modules present are powered from the DC bus and connected by fiber optic cables to the BCU control unit. If all modules of the inverter unit are in fact available (eg. maintenance work has been completed), check that parameter 95.13 Reduced run mode is set to 0 (reduced run function disabled).

aux_codes.cauza: Parameter 95.13 Reduced run mode is set but all PUs are found. Incorrect channel bit.
aux_codes.remediu: Check that parameter 95.12 Reduced run mask is not set according to reduced PUs.

cauza: State feedback from output phases does not match control signals.
remediu: Contact your local ABB representative, quoting the auxiliary code.

cauza: Incorrect parameter setting. ThechargingswitchandDCswitch were operated out of sequence, or a start command was issued before the unit was ready. Charging circuit fault. Brake circuit fault.
remediu: Check the setting of 95.9 Switch fuse controller. The parameter should be enabled only if an xSFC charging controller is installed. The normal power-up sequence is: 1. Close charging switch. 2. After charging finishes (charging OK lamp lights), close DC switch. 3. Open charging switch. Check the charging circuit. With a frame R6i/R7i inverter module, the auxiliary code “FA” indicates that the charging contactor status feedback does not match the control signal. With parallel-connected frame R8i modules, the auxiliary code (format XX00), “XX” specifies the affected BCU control unit channel. Check the wiring and condition of brake resistor.

cauza: Unidentified power unit logic fault.
remediu: Check power unit logic and firmware compatibility. Contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Internal error.
remediu: Contact your local ABB representative, quoting the auxiliary code.

cauza: Firmware and FPGA file version in the power unit are incompatible. Update of power unit logic failed.
remediu: Reboot the control unit (using parameter 96.8 Control board boot) or by cycling power. If the problem persists, contact your local ABB representative. Retry. Check the auxiliary code to identify FPGA version compatibility (format: XXYYZZ). "XX" (8: cannot recognize power unit logic, FPGA logic not compatible, 9 = power unit FPGA logic is old, update FPGA logic, 10 = software is not compatible with power unit FPGA logic, update software (or downgrade power unit FPGA)). YY = BCU control unit channel (first channel = 0)

cauza: The calculated parameter checksum does not match any enabled reference checksum.
remediu: See A686 Checksum mismatch.

cauza: Fieldbus adapter A mapping file read error.
remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Fieldbus adapter B mapping file read error.
remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Internal fault.
remediu: Reboot the control unit (using parameter 96.8 Control board boot) or by cycling power. If the problem persists, contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Internal fault.
remediu: Reboot the control unit (using parameter 96.8 Control board boot) or by cycling power. If the problem persists, contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Firmware malfunction.
remediu: Control unit has rebooted the drive due to CPU error exception, watchdog bark, watchdog bite, or unrecoverable DDR ECC error. If the Drive Composer PC tool is available, send a support package to your local ABB representative. For instructions, see the Drive Composer start-up and maintenance PC tool user’s manual (3AUA0000094606 [English]).

cauza: File read error.
remediu: Reboot the control unit (using parameter 96.8 Control board boot) or by cycling power. If the problem persists, contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Internal record load error.
remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Application file incompatible or corrupted.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code. See actions for each code below.

aux_codes.cauza: Not enough memory for the application.
aux_codes.remediu: Reduce the size of the application. Reduce the number of parameter mappings. See the drive-specific log generated by Automation Builder.

aux_codes.cauza: The application contains the wrong system library version.
aux_codes.remediu: Update the system library or reinstall Automation Builder. See the drive-specific log generated by Automation Builder.

aux_codes.cauza: The application is empty.
aux_codes.remediu: In Automation Builder, give a “Clean” command and reload the application.

aux_codes.cauza: The application contains invalid tasks.
aux_codes.remediu: In Automation Builder, check application task configuration, give a “Clean all” command, and reload the application.

aux_codes.cauza: The application contains an unknown target (system) library function.
aux_codes.remediu: Update the system library or reinstall Automation Builder. See the drive-specific log generated by Automation Builder.

cauza: Running the control program is prevented either because a restrictive license exists, or because a required license is missing.
remediu: Record the auxiliary codes of all active licensing faults and contact your product vendor for further instructions.

cauza: Error running the adaptive program.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code (format XXXX YYYY). “XXXX” specifies the number of the function block (0000 = generic error). “YYYY” indicates the problem (see actions for each code below).

aux_codes.cauza: Program corrupted or block non-existent.
aux_codes.remediu: Restore the template program or download the program to the drive.

aux_codes.cauza: Required block input missing.
aux_codes.remediu: Check the inputs of the block.

aux_codes.cauza: Program corrupted or block non-existent.
aux_codes.remediu: Restore the template program or download the program to the drive.

aux_codes.cauza: Program too large.
aux_codes.remediu: Remove blocks until the error stops.

aux_codes.cauza: Program is empty.
aux_codes.remediu: Correct the program and download it to the drive.

aux_codes.cauza: A nonexisting parameter or block is used in the program.
aux_codes.remediu: Edit the program to correct the parameter reference, or to use an existing block.

aux_codes.cauza: Parameter type invalid for selected pin.
aux_codes.remediu: Edit the program to correct the parameter reference.

aux_codes.cauza: Output to parameter failed because the parameter was write-protected. 0023, 0024 Program file incompatible with current firmware version.
aux_codes.remediu: Check the parameter reference in the program. Check for other sources affecting the target parameter. Adapt the program to current block library and firmware version.

aux_codes.cauza: Too many blocks.
aux_codes.remediu: Edit the program to reduce the number of blocks.

cauza: The memory unit was detached when the control unit was powered.
remediu: Switch off the power to the control unit and reinstall the memory unit. In case the memory unit was not actually removed when the fault occurred, check that the memory unit is properly inserted into its connector and its mounting screw is tight. Reboot the control unit (using parameter 96.8 Control board boot) or by cycling power. If the problem persists, contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Internal fault.
remediu: Reboot the control unit (using parameter 96.8 Control board boot) or by cycling power. If the problem persists, contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Loading of user parameter set failed because • set is not compatible with control program • drive was switched off during loading.
remediu: Ensure that a valid user parameter set exists. Reload if uncertain.

cauza: Operating system error.
remediu: Reboot the control unit (using parameter 96.8 Control board boot) or by cycling power. If the problem persists, contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Informative fault.
remediu: An active fault has been reset.

cauza: Parameter load or save failed.
remediu: Try forcing a save using parameter 96.7 Parameter save manually. Retry.

cauza: Parameter load or save timeout caused by communication break between drive and control panel, or control panel and PC tool.
remediu: Check the communication between drive and control panel or PC. Retry.

cauza: The drive does not have a functionality requested by PLC, or requested functionality has not been activated.
remediu: Check PLC programming. Check settings of parameter groups 50 Fieldbus adapter (FBA) and 51 FBA A settings.

cauza: The drive does not have a functionality requested by PLC, or requested functionality has not been activated.
remediu: Check PLC programming. Check settings of parameter groups 50 Fieldbus adapter (FBA) and 54 FBA B settings.

cauza: A reference source is simultaneously connected to multiple parameters with different units.
remediu: See A6DA Reference source parametrization (page 605).

cauza: Communication break in embedded fieldbus (EFB) communication.
remediu: Check the status of the fieldbus master (online/offline/error etc.). Check cable connections to the XD2D connector on the control unit.

cauza: Embedded fieldbus (EFB) configuration file could not be read.
remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Embedded fieldbus (EFB) parameter settings inconsistent or not compatible with selected protocol.
remediu: Check the settings in parameter group 58 Embedded fieldbus.

cauza: Embedded fieldbus (EFB) protocol firmware could not be loaded. Version mismatch between EFB protocol firmware and drive firmware.
Internal fault.
remediu: Reset the fault. Contact your local ABB representative if the fault persists.

cauza: Internal fault.
remediu: Reset the fault. Contact your local ABB representative if the fault persists.

cauza: Internal fault.
remediu: Reset the fault. Contact your local ABB representative if the fault persists.

cauza: Internal fault.
remediu: Reset the fault. Contact your local ABB representative if the fault persists.

cauza: Communication between drive and an option module is lost.
remediu: See A798 Encoder option comm loss (page 608).

cauza: Control panel (or PC tool) has stopped communicating.
remediu: Check PC tool or control panel connection. Check control panel connector. Disconnect and reconnect the control panel. Check the auxiliary code. The code specifies the I/O port used as follows: 0: Panel, 1: Fieldbus interface A, 2: Fieldbus interface B, 3: Ethernet, 4: D2D/EFB port).

cauza: The I/O extension module types specified by parameters do not match the detected configuration.
remediu: See A799 ExtIO comm loss (page 608).

cauza: Use of saved control panel reference in multiple control modes attempted.
remediu: The control panel reference can only be saved for one reference type at a time. Consider the possibility of using a copied reference instead of saved reference (see the reference selection parameter).

cauza: The current version of the control panel and/or PC tool does not support a function. (For example, older panel versions cannot be used as a source of external reference.)
remediu: Update control panel and/or PC tool. Contact your local ABB representative if necessary.

cauza: Option module not supported. (For example, type Fxxx-xx-M fieldbus adapter modules are not supported.)
remediu: Check the auxiliary code. The code specifies the interface to which the unsupported module is connected: 1: Fieldbus interface A, 2: Fieldbus interface B. Replace the module with a supported type. A - FSO-xx module is not supported by the control board. Remove FSO-xx module to clear the fault. Connect FSO-xx module to the supported control board.

cauza: Motor is operating in stall region because of e.g. excessive load or insufficient motor power.
remediu: Check motor load and drive ratings. Check fault function parameters.

cauza: Motor current is too high.
remediu: Check for overloaded motor. Adjust the parameters used for the motor overload function 35.51...35.53) and 35.55...35.56.

cauza: DC overvoltage detected during braking.
remediu: Check that a brake resistor has been connected. Check the condition of the brake resistor. Check the dimensioning of the brake chopper and resistor.

cauza: Brake resistor temperature has exceeded fault limit defined by parameter 43.11 Brake resistor fault limit.
remediu: Stop drive. Let resistor cool down. Check resistor overload protection function settings (parameter group 43 Brake chopper). Check fault limit setting, parameter 43.11 Brake resistor fault limit. Check that braking cycle meets allowed limits.

cauza: Brake resistor short circuit or brake chopper control fault.
remediu: Check brake chopper and brake resistor connection. Ensure brake resistor is not damaged. After correcting the cause of the fault, reboot the control unit (using parameter 96.8 Control board boot) or by cycling power.

cauza: Short circuit in brake chopper IGBT.
remediu: Ensure brake resistor is connected and not damaged. Check the electrical specifications of the brake resistor against the Hardware manual. Replace brake chopper (if replaceable). After correcting the cause of the fault, reboot the control unit (using parameter 96.8 Control board boot) or by cycling power.

cauza: Brake chopper IGBT temperature has exceeded internal fault limit.
remediu: Let chopper cool down. Check for excessive ambient temperature. Check for cooling fan failure. Check for obstructions in the air flow. Check the dimensioning and cooling of the cabinet. Check resistor overload protection function settings (parameter group 43 Brake chopper). Check that braking cycle meets allowed limits. Check that drive supply AC voltage is not excessive.

cauza: Mechanical brake control fault. Activated eg. if brake acknowledgement is not as expected during brake closing.
remediu: Check mechanical brake connection. Check mechanical brake settings in parameter group 44 Mechanical brake control. Check that acknowledgement signal matches actual status of brake.

cauza: Mechanical brake control fault.
remediu: Check mechanical brake connection. Check that acknowledgement signal matches actual status of brake.

cauza: Open conditions of mechanical brake cannot be fulfilled (for example, brake has been prevented from opening by parameter 44.11 Keep brake closed). In an encoderless application, the brake is kept closed by a brake close request (either from parameter 44.12 Brake close request or from an FSO-xx safety functions module) against a modulating drive for longer than 5 seconds.
remediu: Check mechanical brake settings in parameter group 44 Mechanical brake control (especially 44.11 Keep brake closed). Check that acknowledgement signal (if used) matches actual status of brake. Check the source signal selected by parameter 44.12 Brake close request. Check the safety circuits connected to the FSO-xx safety functions module.

cauza: No feedback received from external fan.
remediu: Check external fan (or other equipment controlled) by the logic. Check settings of parameters 35.100...35.106.

cauza: No motor speed feedback received.
remediu: See A7B0 Motor speed feedback (page 610).

cauza: Motor is turning faster than highest allowed speed due to incorrectly set minimum/maximum speed, insufficient braking torque or changes in load when using torque reference. Incorrect estimated speed.
remediu: Check minimum/maximum speed settings, parameters 30.11 Minimum speed, 30.12 Maximum speed and 31.30 Overspeed trip margin. Check adequacy of motor braking torque. Check applicability of torque control. Check need for brake chopper and resistor(s). Check the status of motor current measurement. Perform a Normal, Advanced or Advanced Standstill ID run instead of, for example, a Reduced or Standstill. See parameter 99.13 ID run requested (page 567).

cauza: Internal fault.
remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Encoder feedback fault.
remediu: See A7E1 Encoder (page 612).

cauza: Speed feedback configuration incorrect.
remediu: See A797 Speed feedback configuration (page 607).

cauza: No load position feedback received.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code (format XXYY ZZZZ). “XX” specifies the number of the encoder interface module (01: 91.11/91.12, 02: 91.13/91.14), “YY” specifies the encoder (01: 92 Encoder 1 configuration, 02: 93 Encoder 2 configuration). “ZZZZ” indicates the problem (see actions for each code below).

aux_codes.cauza: Encoder stopped working.
aux_codes.remediu: Check encoder status.

aux_codes.cauza: Feed constant definition invalid or outside limits.
aux_codes.remediu: Check feed constant settings (90.63 and 90.64).

aux_codes.cauza: Motor/load gear definition invalid or outside limits.
aux_codes.remediu: Check motor/load gear settings (90.61 and 90.62).

aux_codes.cauza: Encoder not configured.
aux_codes.remediu: Check encoder settings (92 Encoder 1 configuration or 93 Encoder 2 configuration). Use parameter 91.10 Encoder parameter refresh) to validate any changes in the settings.

aux_codes.cauza: Encoder stopped working.
aux_codes.remediu: Check encoder status.

cauza: Emergency stop did not finish within expected time.
remediu: Check the settings of parameters 31.32 Emergencyrampsupervisionand31.33 Emergency ramp supervision delay. Check the predefined ramp times (23.11...23.19 for mode Off1, 23.23 for mode Off3).

cauza: Ramp stop did not finish within expected time.
remediu: Check the settings of parameters 31.37 Ramp stop supervision and 31.38 Ramp stop supervision delay. Check the predefined ramp times in parameter group 23 Speed reference ramp.

cauza: Maximum allowed output frequency exceeded.
remediu: Without a dual-use license, the fault limit is 598 Hz. Contact your local ABB representative for dual-use licensing information.

cauza: Cyclical communication between drive and fieldbus adapter module A or between PLC and fieldbus adapter module A is lost.
remediu: Check status of fieldbus communication. See user documentation of fieldbus interface. Check settings of parameter groups 50 Fieldbus adapter (FBA), 51 FBA A settings, 52 FBA A data in and 53 FBA A data out. Check cable connections. Check if communication master is able to communicate.

aux_codes.cauza: Communication problem between adapter and control unit.
aux_codes.remediu: Check communication connections between adapter and drive.

aux_codes.cauza: Communication problem between adapter and PLC or parameters refreshed using the parameter 51.27 FBA A par refresh while PLC was communicating with the adapter.
aux_codes.remediu: Refresh parameters only when necessary to avoid loss of communication.

aux_codes.cauza: Lost communication with fieldbus communication adapter.
aux_codes.remediu: Check fieldbus communication adapter.

cauza: Cyclical communication between drive and fieldbus adapter module B or between PLC and fieldbus adapter module B is lost.
remediu: Check status of fieldbus communication. See user documentation of fieldbus interface. Check settings of parameter group 50 Fieldbus adapter (FBA). Check cable connections. Check if communication master is able to communicate.

aux_codes.cauza: Communication problem between adapter and drive.
aux_codes.remediu: Check communication connections between adapter and drive.

aux_codes.cauza: Communication problem between adapter and PLC or parameters refreshed using the parameter 51.27 FBA A par refresh while PLC was communicating with the adapter.
aux_codes.remediu: Refresh parameters only when necessary to avoid loss of communication.

aux_codes.cauza: Lost communication with fieldbus communication adapter.
aux_codes.remediu: Check fieldbus communication adapter.

cauza: DDCS (fiber optic) communication between converters (for example, the inverter unit and the supply unit) is lost.
remediu: Check status of other converter (parameter group 6 Control and status words). Check settings of parameter group 60 DDCS communication. Check the corresponding settings in the control program of the other converter. Check cable connections. If necessary, replace cables.

cauza: DDCS (fiber optic) communication between drive and external controller is lost.
remediu: Check status of controller. See user documentation of controller. Check settings of parameter group 60 DDCS communication. Check cable connections. If necessary, replace cables.

cauza: Master/follower communication is lost.
remediu: See A7CB M/F comm loss (page 612).

cauza: The supply unit (or other converter) connected to the inverter unit has generated a fault.
remediu: The auxiliary code specifies the original fault code in the supply unit control program. See section Auxiliary codes for line-side converter faults (page 625).

cauza: The supply unit was not ready (ie. the main contactor/breaker could not be closed) within expected time.
remediu: Check that communication to the supply unit has been activated by 95.20 HW options word 1. Check setting of parameter 94.10 LSU max charging time. Check that the supply unit is enabled, allowed to start, and can be controlled by the inverter unit (eg. not in local control mode).

cauza: Selected signal has fallen below the user underload curve.
remediu: See A8BF ULC underload (page 615).

cauza: Selected signal has exceeded the user overload curve.
remediu: See A8BE ULC overload (page 615).

cauza: An analog signal is outside the limits specified for the analog input.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code (format XXXX XYZZ). “Y” specifies the location of the input (0: Control unit, 1: I/O extension module 1, 2: I/O extension module 2, 3: I/O extension module 3). “ZZ” specifies the limit (01: AI1 under minimum, 02: AI1 above maximum, 03: AI2 under minimum, 04: AI2 above maximum). Check signal level at the analog input. Check the wiring connected to the input. Check the minimum and maximum limits of the input in parameter group 12 Standard AI.

cauza: Fault generated by the signal supervision 1 function.
remediu: Check the source of the fault (parameter 32.7 Supervision 1 signal).

cauza: Fault generated by the signal supervision 2 function.
remediu: Check the source of the fault (parameter 32.17 Supervision 2 signal).

cauza: Fault generated by the signal supervision 3 function.
remediu: Check the source of the fault (parameter 32.27 Supervision 3 signal).

cauza: Fault in external device 1.
remediu: Check the external device. Check setting of parameter 31.1 External event 1 source.

cauza: Fault in external device 2.
remediu: Check the external device. Check setting of parameter 31.3 External event 2 source.

cauza: Fault in external device 3.
remediu: Check the external device. Check setting of parameter 31.5 External event 3 source.

cauza: Fault in external device 4.
remediu: Check the external device. Check setting of parameter 31.7 External event 4 source.

cauza: Fault in external device 5.
remediu: Check the external device. Check setting of parameter 31.9 External event 5 source.

cauza: Current offset and gain measurement calibration will occur at next start.
remediu: Informative warning. (See parameter 99.13 ID run requested.)

cauza: Drive has detected load unbalance typically due to earth fault in motor or motor cable.
remediu: Check there are no power factor correction capacitors or surge absorbers in motor cable. Check for an earth fault in motor or motor cables by measuring the insulation resistances of motor and motor cable. Try running the motor in scalar control mode if allowed. (See parameter 99.4 Motor control mode.) If no earth fault can be detected, contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Short-circuit in motor cable(s) or motor.
remediu: Check motor and motor cable for cabling errors. Check there are no power factor correction capacitors or surge absorbers in motor cable.

cauza: Excessive IGBT junction to case temperature. This warning protects the IGBT(s) and can be activated by a short circuit in the motor cable.
remediu: Check motor cable. Check ambient conditions. Check air flow and fan operation. Check heatsink fins for dust pick-up. Check motor power against drive power.

cauza: Intermediate circuit DC voltage too high (when the drive is stopped).
remediu: Check the supply voltage setting (parameter 95.1 Supply voltage). Note that the wrong setting of the parameter may cause the motor to rush uncontrollably, or may overload the brake chopper or resistor. Check the supply voltage. If the problem persists, contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Intermediate circuit DC voltage too low (when the drive is stopped).
remediu: Check the supply voltage setting (parameter 95.1 Supply voltage). Note that the wrong setting of the parameter may cause the motor to rush uncontrollably, or may overload the brake chopper or resistor. Check the supply voltage. If the problem persists, contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: The voltage of the intermediate DC circuit has not yet risen to operating level.
remediu: Check the supply voltage setting (parameter 95.1 Supply voltage). Note that the wrong setting of the parameter may cause the motor to rush uncontrollably, or may overload the brake chopper or resistor. Check the supply voltage. If the problem persists, contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Calculated motor cable temperature has exceeded warning limit.
remediu: Check the settings of parameters 35.61 and 35.62. Check the dimensioning of the motor cable in regard to required load.

cauza: Problem with motor temperature measurement.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code (format 0XYY ZZZZ). “X” identifies the affected temperature monitoring function (1 = parameter 35.11, 2 = parameter 35.21). “YY” indicates the selected temperature source, ie. the setting of the selection parameter in hexadecimal. “ZZZZ” indicates the problem (see actions for each code below).

aux_codes.cauza: Sensor type mismatch.
aux_codes.remediu: Check parameters 35.11/35.21 against 91.21/91.24.

aux_codes.cauza: Temperature under limit.
aux_codes.remediu: Check parameters 35.11...35.14/35.21...35.24 (and 91.21/91.24 if sensor is connected to an encoder interface). Check the sensor and its wiring.

aux_codes.cauza: Short circuit.
aux_codes.remediu: Check parameters 35.11...35.14/35.21...35.24 (and 91.21/91.24 if sensor is connected to an encoder interface). Check the sensor and its wiring.

aux_codes.cauza: Open circuit.
aux_codes.remediu: Check parameters 35.11...35.14/35.21...35.24 (and 91.21/91.24 if sensor is connected to an encoder interface). Check the sensor and its wiring.

cauza: Measured temperature 1 has exceeded warning limit.
remediu: Check the value of parameter 35.2 Measured temperature 1. Check the cooling of the motor (or other equipment whose temperature is being measured). Check the value of 35.13 Temperature 1 warning limit.

cauza: Measuredtemperature2hasexceeded warning limit.
remediu: Check the value of parameter 35.3 Measured temperature 2. Check the cooling of the motor (or other equipment whose temperature is being measured). Check the value of 35.23 Temperature 2 warning limit.

cauza: The thermistor protection module installed in slot 1 indicates overtemperature.
remediu: Check the cooling of the motor. Check the motor load and drive ratings. Check the wiring of the temperature sensor. Repair wiring if faulty. Measure the resistance of the sensor. Replace sensor if faulty.

cauza: The thermistor protection module installed in slot 2 indicates overtemperature.
remediu: Check the cooling of the motor. Check the motor load and drive ratings. Check the wiring of the temperature sensor. Repair wiring if faulty. Measure the resistance of the sensor. Replace sensor if faulty.

cauza: The thermistor protection module installed in slot 3 indicates overtemperature.
remediu: Check the cooling of the motor. Check the motor load and drive ratings. Check the wiring of the temperature sensor. Repair wiring if faulty. Measure the resistance of the sensor. Replace sensor if faulty.

cauza: Control unit temperature is excessive. Temperature above warning limit. Thermistor broken.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code. See actions for each code below. Check ambient conditions. Check air flow and fan operation. Check heatsink fins for dust pick-up. Contact an ABB service representative for control unit replacement.

cauza: Drive module temperature is excessive.
remediu: Check ambient temperature. If it exceeds 40 °C (104 °F), ensure that load current does not exceed derated load capacity of drive. See appropriate Hardware manual. Check drive module cooling air flow and fan operation. Check inside of cabinet and heatsink of drive module for dust pick-up. Clean whenever necessary.

cauza: Power unit temperature is excessive.
remediu: Check ambient conditions. Check air flow and fan operation. Check the setting of 31.36 Aux fan fault function (if present). Check heatsink fins for dust pick-up. Check motor power against drive power. See A5EA Measurement circuit temperature (page 602).

cauza: High temperature difference between the IGBTs of different phases.
remediu: Check the motor cabling. Check cooling of drive module(s). Check the auxiliary code (format XXXY YYZZ). “XXX” indicates the source of difference (0: Single module, difference between phase IGBTs, 1: parallelconnected modules, minimum-maximum difference between all IGBTs of all modules, 2: parallel-connected modules, minimum-maximum difference between auxiliary power supply boards). With parallel-connected modules, “Y YY” specifies through which BCU control unit channel the highest temperature was measured. “ZZ” specifies the phase (0: single module, 1: U-phase [parallel connection], 2: V-phase [parallel connection], 3: W-phase [parallel connection]).

cauza: Drive IGBT temperature is excessive.
remediu: Check ambient conditions. Check air flow and fan operation. Check heatsink fins for dust pick-up. Check motor power against drive power.

cauza: Communication errors detected between the drive control unit and the power unit.
remediu: Check the connections between the drive control unit and the power unit. Check the auxiliary code (format XXXY YYZZ). With parallel-connected modules, “Y YY” specifies the affected BCU control unit channel (0: broadcast). “ZZ” specifies the error source (8: Transmission errors in PSL link [see “XXX”], 9: Transmitter FIFO warning limit hit). “XXX” specifies the transmission error direction and detailed warning code (0: Rx/communication error, 1: Tx/Reed-Solomon symbol error, 2: Tx/no synchronization error, 3: Tx/Reed-Solomon decoder failures, 4: Tx/Manchester coding errors). Read the PSL2 data log. In Drive Composer pro, check the time stamp of the A580 fault. Load the log with the same date and time. When the file opens, click “Show fault log”. Check the power unit hardware.

cauza: Cooling fan feedback missing.
remediu: Check the setting of parameter 95.20 HW options word 1, bit 14. Check the auxiliary code to identify the fan. Code 0 denotes main fan 1. Other codes (format XYZ): “X” specifies state code (1: ID run, 2: normal). “Y” specifies the index of the inverter module connected to BCU (0...n, always 0 for ZCU control units). “Z” specifies the index of the fan (1: Main fan 1, 2: Main fan 2, 3: Main fan 3). Note that modules are coded starting from 0. For example, the code 101 means that Main fan 1 of module 1 (connected to BCU channel V1T/V1R) has faulted during its ID run. Check fan operation and connection. Replace fan if faulty.

cauza: An auxiliary cooling fan (connected to the fan connectors on the control unit) is stuck or disconnected.
remediu: The auxiliary code identifies the fan (1: Auxiliary fan 1, 2: Auxiliary fan 2). Check that the auxiliary fan supervision selection in parameter 95.21 HW options word 2 matches the hardware. Make sure the front cover of the drive module is in place and tightened. Check auxiliary fan(s) and connection(s). Replace faulty fan.

cauza: Safe torque off function is active, i.e. safety circuit signal(s) connected to connector XSTO is lost.
remediu: Check safety circuit connections. For more information, see appropriate drive hardware manual and description of parameter 31.22 STO indication run/stop (page 353).

cauza: Problem with internal temperature measurement of the drive.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code (format XXXY YYZZ). “Y YY” specifies through which BCU control unit channel the fault was received (“0 00” with a ZCU control unit). “ZZ” specifies the location: With control program version 2.8x and later: 1: U-phase IGBT, 2: V-phase IGBT, 3: W-phase IGBT, 4: Power supply board, 5: Power unit xINT board, 6: Brake chopper, 7: Air inlet (TEMP3, X10), 8: du/dt filter (TEMP2, X7), 9: TEMP1 (X6) Power supply heatsink on ACS880-x04LC frame R7i module. With control program version up to and including 2.7x: 1: U-phase IGBT, 2: V-phase IGBT, 3: W-phase IGBT, 4: Power unit INT board, 5: Brake chopper, 6: Air inlet, 7: Power supply board, 8: du/dt filter, FAh: Air in temp.

cauza: Power unit power supply failure.
remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Communication errors detected between the drive control unit and the power unit.
remediu: Check the connections between the drive control unit and the power unit.

cauza: Problem with measurement circuit of power unit (analog to digital converter).
remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Problem with current or voltage measurement of power unit.
remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: State feedback from output phases does not match control signals.
remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Charging in progress.
remediu: Informative warning. Wait until charging finishes before starting the inverter unit. Charging with the manual fuse switch controller (xSFC) must be ended within two minutes. After that the warning informs that the charging resistor is still connected.

cauza: Adequate motor control at requested output frequency cannot be reached because of limited switching frequency (eg. by parameter 95.15).
remediu: Informative warning.

cauza: The battery of the control unit is low.
remediu: Replace control unit battery. This warning can be suppressed using parameter 31.40.

cauza: The flash memory (in the memory unit) has been erased too frequently, compromising the lifetime of the memory.
remediu: Avoid forcing unnecessary parameter saves by parameter 96.7 or cyclic parameter writes (such as user logger triggering through parameters). Check the auxiliary code (format XYYY YZZZ). “X” specifies the source of warning (1: generic flash erase supervision). “ZZZ” specifies the flash subsector number that generated the warning.

cauza: An error in saving data to the power unit. An error is preventing saving from initializing. Write error.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code. See actions for each code below. Cycle the power to the drive. If the control unit is externally powered, also reboot the control unit (using parameter 96.8 Control board boot) or by cycling its power. If the problem persists, contact your local ABB representative. Cycle the power to the drive. If the control unit is externally powered, also reboot the control unit (using parameter 96.8 Control board boot) or by cycling its power. If the problem persists, contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Error related to SD card used to store data (BCU control unit only). No SD card. SD card write-protected. SD card unreadable. SD card initialization failed.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code. See actions for each code below. Insert a compatible, writable SD card into the SD CARD slot of the BCU control unit. Insert a compatible, writable SD card into the SD CARD slot of the BCU control unit. Insert a compatible, writable SD card into the SD CARD slot of the BCU control unit. Insert a compatible, writable SD card into the SD CARD slot of the BCU control unit.

cauza: Power fail saving is requested too frequently. Because of the limited saving interval, some of the requests do not trigger the saving and power fail data may be lost. This may be caused by DC voltage oscillation.
remediu: Check the supply voltage.

cauza: The calculated parameter checksum does not match any enabled reference checksum.
remediu: Check that all necessary approved (reference) checksums (96.56...96.59) are enabled in 96.55 Checksum control word. Check the parameter configuration. Using 96.55 Checksum control word, enable a checksum parameter and copy the actual checksum into that parameter.

cauza: An action has been defined for a parameter checksum mismatch but the feature has not been configured.
remediu: Contact your local ABB representative for configuring the feature, or disable the feature in 96.54 Checksum action.

cauza: Too much data in parameter mapping table created in Drive customizer.
remediu: See the Drive customizer PC tool user’s manual (3AUA0000104167 [English]).

cauza: Parameter value saturated eg. by the scaling specified in parameter mapping table (created in Drive customizer).
remediu: Check parameter scaling and format in parameter mapping table. See the Drive customizer PC tool user’s manual (3AUA0000104167 [English]).

cauza: The motor parameters are set incorrectly. The drive is not dimensioned correctly. Slip frequency is too small. Synchronous and nominal speeds differ too much. Nominal speed is higher than synchronous speed with 1 pole pair. Nominal current is outside limits. Nominal voltage is outside limits. Mechanical nominal power is higher than electrical active power. Nominal power not consistent with nominal speed and torque.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code. See actions for each code below. Check the settings of the motor configuration parameters in groups 98 and 99. Check that the drive is sized correctly for the motor. Check the settings of the motor configuration parameters in groups 98 and 99. Check that the drive is sized correctly for the motor. Check the settings of the motor configuration parameters in groups 98 and 99. Check that the drive is sized correctly for the motor. Check the settings of the motor configuration parameters in groups 98 and 99. Check that the drive is sized correctly for the motor. Check the settings of the motor configuration parameters in groups 98 and 99. Check that the drive is sized correctly for the motor. Check the settings of the motor configuration parameters in groups 98 and 99. Check that the drive is sized correctly for the motor. Check the settings of the motor configuration parameters in groups 98 and 99. Check that the drive is sized correctly for the motor.

cauza: Parameters in group 99 have not been set.
remediu: Check that all the required parameters in group 99 have been set. Note: It is normal for this warning to appear during the start-up and continue until the motor data is entered.

cauza: The supply voltage has not been defined.
remediu: Set supply voltage in parameter 95.1 Supply voltage.

cauza: The user lock is open, ie. user lock configuration parameters 96.100...96.102 are visible.
remediu: Close the user lock by entering an invalid pass code in parameter 96.2 Pass code. See section User lock (page 105).

cauza: A new user pass code has been entered in parameter 96.100 but not confirmed in 96.101.
remediu: Confirm the new pass code by entering the same code in 96.101. To cancel, close the user lock without confirming the new code. See section User lock (page 105).

cauza: The drive does not have a functionality requested by a PLC, or requested functionality has not been activated.
remediu: Check PLC programming. Check settings of parameter groups 50 Fieldbus adapter (FBA) and 51 FBA A settings.

cauza: The drive does not have a functionality requested by a PLC, or requested functionality has not been activated.
remediu: Check PLC programming. Check settings of parameter groups 50 Fieldbus adapter (FBA) and 54 FBA B settings.

cauza: A reference source is simultaneously connected to multiple parameters with different units.
remediu: Check the reference source selection parameters. Check the auxiliary code (format XXYY 00ZZ). “XX” and “YY” specify the two sets of parameters where the source was connected to (01 = speed reference chain [22.11, 22.12, 22.15, 22.17], 02 = frequency reference chain [28.11, 28.12], 03 = torque reference chain [26.11, 26.12, 26.16], 04 = other torque-related parameters [26.25, 30.21, 30.22, 44.9], 05 = process PID control parameters [40.16, 40.17, 40.50, 41.16, 41.17, 41.50]). “ZZ” indicates the conflicting reference source (01...0E = index in parameter group 3, 33 = process PID control, 3D = motor potentiometer, 65 = AI1, 66 = AI2, 6F = frequency input).

cauza: The current/voltage hardware setting of an analog input does not correspond to parameter settings.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code. The code identifies the analog input whose settings are in conflict. Adjust either the hardware setting (on the drive control unit) or parameter 12.15/12.25. Note: Control board reboot (either by cycling the power or through parameter 96.8 Control board boot) is required to validate any changes in the hardware settings.

cauza: User load curve configuration error.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code (format XXXX ZZZZ). “ZZZZ” indicates the problem (see actions for each code below).

aux_codes.cauza: Speed points inconsistent.
aux_codes.remediu: Check that each speed point (parameters 37.11...37.15) has a higher value than the previous point.

aux_codes.cauza: Frequency points inconsistent.
aux_codes.remediu: Check that each frequency point (37.16...37.20) has a higher value than the previous point.

aux_codes.cauza: Underload point above overload point.
aux_codes.remediu: Check that each overload point (37.31...37.35) has a higher value than the corresponding underload point (37.21...37.25).

aux_codes.cauza: Overload point below underload point.
aux_codes.remediu: Check that each overload point (37.31...37.35) has a higher value than the corresponding underload point (37.21...37.25).

cauza: Motor is operating in stall region because of e.g. excessive load or insufficient motor power.
remediu: Check motor load and drive ratings. Check fault function parameters.

cauza: No feedback received from external fan.
remediu: Check external fan (or other equipment controlled) by the logic. Check settings of parameters 35.100...35.106.

cauza: Errorintemperaturemeasurement when temperature sensor (KTY or PTC) connected to encoder interface FEN-xx is used. Errorintemperaturemeasurement when KTY sensor connected to encoder interface FEN-01 is used.
remediu: Check that parameter 35.11 Temperature 1 source / 35.21 Temperature 2 source setting corresponds to actual encoder interface installation. Check the settings of parameters 91.21 and 91.24. Check that the correspondingmoduleisactivated in parameters 91.11...91.14. Use parameter 91.10 Encoder parameter refresh to validate any changes in the settings. FEN-01 does not support temperature measurement with KTY sensor. Use PTC sensor or other encoder interface module.

cauza: Motor current is too high.
remediu: Check for overloaded motor. Adjust the parameters used for the motoroverloadfunction(35.51...35.53) and 35.55...35.56.

cauza: Brake resistor broken or not connected.
remediu: Check that a brake resistor has been connected. Check the condition of the brake resistor.

cauza: Brake resistor temperature has exceeded warning limit defined by parameter 43.12 Brake resistor warning limit.
remediu: Stop drive. Let resistor cool down. Check resistor overload protection function settings (parameter group 43 Brake chopper). Check warning limit setting, parameter 43.12 Brake resistor warning limit. Check that the resistor has been dimensioned correctly. Check that braking cycle meets allowed limits.

cauza: Brake resistor data has not been given.
remediu: One or more of the resistor data settings (parameters 43.8...43.10) is incorrect. The parameter is specified by the auxiliary code.

aux_codes.cauza: Resistance value too low.
aux_codes.remediu: Check value of 43.10.

aux_codes.cauza: Thermal time constant not given.
aux_codes.remediu: Check value of 43.8.

aux_codes.cauza: Maximumcontinuouspowernotgiven.
aux_codes.remediu: Check value of 43.9.

cauza: Speed feedback configuration has changed.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code (format XXYY ZZZZ). “XX” specifies the number of the encoder interface module (01: 91.11/91.12, 02: 91.13/91.14, “YY” specifies the encoder (01: 92 Encoder 1 configuration, 02: 93 Encoder 2 configuration). “ZZZZ” indicates the problem (see actions for each code below).

aux_codes.cauza: Adapter not found in specified slot.
aux_codes.remediu: Check module location (91.12 or 91.14).

aux_codes.cauza: Detected type of interface module does not match parameter setting.
aux_codes.remediu: Check the module type (91.11 or 91.13) against status (91.2 or 91.3).

aux_codes.cauza: Logic version too old.
aux_codes.remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

aux_codes.cauza: Software version too old.
aux_codes.remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

aux_codes.cauza: Encoder type incompatible with interface module type.
aux_codes.remediu: Check module type (91.11 or 91.13) against encoder type (92.1 or 93.1).

aux_codes.cauza: Adapter not configured.
aux_codes.remediu: Check module location (91.12 or 91.14).

aux_codes.cauza: Speed feedback configuration has changed.
aux_codes.remediu: Use parameter 91.10 Encoder parameter refresh to validate any changes in the settings.

aux_codes.cauza: No encoders configured to encoder module.
aux_codes.remediu: Configure the encoder in group 92 Encoder 1 configuration or 93 Encoder 2 configuration.

aux_codes.cauza: Non-existing emulation input.
aux_codes.remediu: Check input selection (91.31 or 91.41).

aux_codes.cauza: Echo not supported by selected input (for example, resolver or absolute encoder).
aux_codes.remediu: Check input selection (91.31 or 91.41), interface module type, and encoder type.

aux_codes.cauza: Emulation in continuous mode not supported.
aux_codes.remediu: Check input selection (91.31 or 91.41) and serial link mode (92.30 or 93.30) settings.

cauza: Encoder feedback not used as actual feedback, or measured motor feedback lost (and parameter 90.45/90.55 is set to Warning).
remediu: Check that the encoder is selected as feedback source in parameter 90.41 or 90.51. Check that the encoder interface module is properly seated in its slot. Check that the encoder interface module or slot connectors are not damaged. To pinpoint the problem, try installing the module into a different slot. If the module is installed on an FEA-03 extension adapter, check the fiber optic connections. Check the auxiliary code (format XXXX YYYY). “YYYY” indicates the problem (see actions for each code below).

aux_codes.cauza: Failed answer to encoder configuration message.
aux_codes.remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

aux_codes.cauza: Failed answer to adapter watchdog disable message.

aux_codes.remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: The I/O extension module types specified by parameters do not match the detected configuration.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code (format XXYY YYYY). “XX” specifies the number of the I/O extension module (01: parameter group 14 I/O extension module 1, 02: 15 I/O extension module 2 2, 03: 16 I/O extension module 3). “YY YYYY” indicates the problem (see actions for each code below).

aux_codes.cauza: Communication with module failed.
aux_codes.remediu: Check that the module is properly seated in its slot. Check that the module and the slot connector is not damaged. Try installing the module into another slot.

aux_codes.cauza: Module not found.
aux_codes.remediu: Check the type and location settings of the modules (parameters 14.1/14.2, 15.1/15.2 or 16.1/16.2). Check that the module is properly seated in its slot. Check that the module and the slot connector is not damaged. Try installing the module into another slot.

aux_codes.cauza: Configuration of module failed.
aux_codes.remediu: Check the type and location settings of the modules (parameters 14.1/14.2, 15.1/15.2 or 16.1/16.2). Check that the module is properly seated in its slot. Check that the module and the slot connector is not damaged. Try installing the module into another slot.

aux_codes.cauza: Configuration of module failed.
aux_codes.remediu: Check the type and location settings of the modules (parameters 14.1/14.2, 15.1/15.2 or 16.1/16.2). Check that the module is properly seated in its slot. Check that the module and the slot connector is not damaged. Try installing the module into another slot.

cauza: Short circuit in brake chopper IGBT.
remediu: Replace brake chopper if external. Drives with internal choppers will need to be returned to ABB. Ensure brake resistor is connected and not damaged.

cauza: Brake chopper IGBT temperature has exceeded internal warning limit.
remediu: Let chopper cool down. Check for excessive ambient temperature. Check for cooling fan failure. Check for obstructions in the air flow. Check the dimensioning and cooling of the cabinet. Check resistor overload protection function settings (parameters 43.6...43.10). Check minimum allowed resistor value for the chopper being used. Check that braking cycle meets allowed limits. Check that drive supply AC voltage is not excessive.

cauza: Status of mechanical brake acknowledgement is not as expected during brake close.
remediu: Check mechanical brake connection. Check mechanical brake settings in parameter group 44 Mechanical brake control. Check that acknowledgement signal matches actual status of brake.

cauza: Status of mechanical brake acknowledgement is not as expected during brake open.
remediu: Check mechanical brake connection. Check mechanical brake settings in parameter group 44 Mechanical brake control. Check that acknowledgement signal matches actual status of brake.

cauza: Open conditions of mechanical brake cannot be fulfilled (for example, brake has been prevented from opening by parameter 44.11 Keep brake closed).
remediu: Check mechanical brake settings in parameter group 44 Mechanical brake control (especially 44.11 Keep brake closed). Check that acknowledgement signal (if used) matches actual status of brake.

cauza: The hardware current/voltage setting of an analog input (on an I/O extension module) does not correspond to parameter settings.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code (format XX00 00YY). “XX” specifies the number of the I/O extension module (01: parameter group 14 I/O extension module 1, 02: 15 I/O extension module 2, 03: 16 I/O extension module 3). “YY” specifies the analog input on the module. For example, in case of I/O extension module 1, analog input AI1 (auxiliary code 0100 0000), the hardware current/voltage setting on the module is shown by parameter 14.29. The corresponding parameter setting is 14.30. Adjust either the hardware setting on the module or the parameter to solve the mismatch. Note: Control board reboot (either by cycling the power or through parameter 96.8 Control board boot) is required to validate any changes in the hardware settings.

cauza: The I/O extension module types and locations specified by parameters do not match the detected configuration.
remediu: Check the type and location settings of the modules (parameters 14.1, 14.2, 15.1, 15.2, 16.1 and 16.2). Check that the modules are properly installed. Check the auxiliary code. See Drive application programming manual (IEC 61131-3) (3AUA0000127808 [English]).

cauza: No motor speed feedback is received.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code (format XXYY ZZZZ). “XX” specifies the number of the encoder interface module (01: 91.11/91.12, 02: 91.13/91.14), “YY” specifies the encoder (01: 92 Encoder 1 configuration, 02: 93 Encoder 2 configuration). “ZZZZ” indicates the problem (see actions for each code below).

aux_codes.cauza: Motor gear definition invalid or outside limits.
aux_codes.remediu: Check motor gear settings (90.43 and 90.44).

aux_codes.cauza: Encoder not configured.
aux_codes.remediu: Check encoder settings (92 Encoder 1 configuration or 93 Encoder 2 configuration). Use parameter 91.10 Encoder parameter refresh) to validate any changes in the settings.

aux_codes.cauza: Encoder stopped working.
aux_codes.remediu: Check encoder status.

aux_codes.cauza: Encoder drift detected.
aux_codes.remediu: Check for slippage between encoder and motor.

cauza: No load speed feedback is received.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code (format XXYY ZZZZ). “XX” specifies the number of the encoder interface module (01: 91.11/91.12, 02: 91.13/91.14), “YY” specifies the encoder (01: 92 Encoder 1 configuration, 02: 93 Encoder 2 configuration). “ZZZZ” indicates the problem (see actions for each code below).

aux_codes.cauza: Load gear definition invalid or outside limits.
aux_codes.remediu: Check load gear settings (90.53 and 90.54).

aux_codes.cauza: Feed constant definition invalid or outside limits.
aux_codes.remediu: Check feed constant settings (90.63 and 90.64).

aux_codes.cauza: Encoder stopped working.
aux_codes.remediu: Check encoder status.

aux_codes.cauza: Encoder drift detected.
aux_codes.remediu: Check for slippage between encoder and motor.

cauza: Cyclical communication between drive and fieldbus adapter module A or between PLC and fieldbus adapter module A is lost.
remediu: Check status of fieldbus communication. See user documentation of fieldbus interface. Check settings of parameter groups 50 Fieldbus adapter (FBA), 51 FBA A settings, 52 FBA A data in and 53 FBA A data out. Check cable connections. Check if communication master is able to communicate.

aux_codes.cauza: Communication problem between adapter and drive.
aux_codes.remediu: Check communication connections between adapter and drive.

aux_codes.cauza: Communication problem between adapter and PLC or parameters refreshed using the parameter 51.27 FBA A par refresh.
aux_codes.remediu: Check communication connections between adapter and PLC. Stop using parameter 51.27 FBA A par refresh to refresh parameters.

aux_codes.cauza: Lost communication with fieldbus communication adapter. Other aux Unknown internal issues. code value
aux_codes.remediu: Check fieldbus communication adapter. Contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Cyclical communication between drive and fieldbus adapter module B or between PLC and fieldbus adapter module B is lost.
remediu: Check status of fieldbus communication. See user documentation of fieldbus interface. Check settings of parameter group 50 Fieldbus adapter (FBA). Check cable connections. Check if communication master is able to communicate.

aux_codes.cauza: Communication problem between adapter and drive.
aux_codes.remediu: Check communication connections between adapter and drive.

aux_codes.cauza: Communication problem between adapter and PLC or parameters refreshed using the parameter 51.27 FBA A par refresh.
aux_codes.remediu: Check communication connections between adapter and PLC. Stop using parameter 51.27 FBA A par refresh to refresh parameters.

aux_codes.cauza: Lost communication with fieldbus communication adapter. Other aux Unknown internal issues. code value
aux_codes.remediu: Check fieldbus communication adapter. Contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: DDCS (fiber optic) communication between drive and external controller is lost.
remediu: Check status of controller. See user documentation of controller. Check settings of parameter group 60 DDCS communication. Check cable connections. If necessary, replace cables.

cauza: Master/follower communication is lost.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code. The code indicates which node address (defined by parameter 60.2 in each drive) on the master/follower link is affected. Check settings of parameter group 60 DDCS communication. On the FDCO module (if present), check that the DDCS link switch is not set to 0 (OFF). Check cable connections. If necessary, replace cables.

cauza: Communication break in embedded fieldbus (EFB) communication.
remediu: Check the status of the fieldbus master (online/offline/error etc.). Check cable connections to the XD2D connector on the control unit.

cauza: Encoder error.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code (format XXYY ZZZZ). “XX” specifies the number of the encoder interface module (01: 91.11/91.12, 02: 91.13/91.14), “YY” specifies the encoder (01: 92 Encoder 1 configuration, 02: 93 Encoder 2 configuration). “ZZZZ” indicates the problem (see actions for each code below).

aux_codes.cauza: Cable fault.
aux_codes.remediu: Check the conductor order at both ends of the encoder cable. Check the groundings of the encoder cable. If the encoder was working previously, check the encoder, encoder cable and encoder interface module for damage. See also parameter 92.21 Encoder cable fault mode.

aux_codes.cauza: No encoder signal.
aux_codes.remediu: Check the condition of the encoder.

aux_codes.cauza: Overspeed.
aux_codes.remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

aux_codes.cauza: Encoder reported a battery error.
aux_codes.remediu: See the documentation of the encoder.

aux_codes.remediu: See the documentation of the encoder.

aux_codes.remediu: See the documentation of the encoder.

aux_codes.cauza: Encoder reported an internal error.
aux_codes.remediu: See the documentation of the encoder.

cauza: Control panel (or PC tool) has stopped communicating.
remediu: Check PC tool or control panel connection. Check control panel connector. Check mounting platform if being used. Disconnect and reconnect the control panel.

cauza: Warning generated by an ontime timer or a value counter.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code. Check the source of the warning corresponding to the code: 0: 33.13 On-time 1 source 1: 33.23 On-time 2 source 4: 33.53 Value counter 1 source 5: 33.63 Value counter 2 source.

cauza: Warning generated by an edge counter. Programmable warnings: 33.35 Edge counter 1 warn message 33.45 Edge counter 2 warn message
remediu: Check the auxiliary code. Check the source of the warning corresponding to the code: 2: 33.33 Edge counter 1 source 3: 33.43 Edge counter 2 source.

cauza: Warning generated by an edge counter. Programmable warnings: 33.35 Edge counter 1 warn message 33.45 Edge counter 2 warn message
remediu: Check the auxiliary code. Check the source of the warning corresponding to the code: 2: 33.33 Edge counter 1 source 3: 33.43 Edge counter 2 source.

cauza: Warning generated by an edge counter. Programmable warnings: 33.35 Edge counter 1 warn message 33.45 Edge counter 2 warn message
remediu: Check the auxiliary code. Check the source of the warning corresponding to the code: 2: 33.33 Edge counter 1 source 3: 33.43 Edge counter 2 source.

remediu: Check the auxiliary code. Check the source of the warning corresponding to the code: 2: 33.33 Edge counter 1 source 3: 33.43 Edge counter 2 source.

remediu: Check the auxiliary code. Check the source of the warning corresponding to the code: 2: 33.33 Edge counter 1 source 3: 33.43 Edge counter 2 source.

remediu: Check the source of the warning (parameter 33.13 On-time 1 source).

cauza: Warning generated by on-time timer 2.
remediu: Check the source of the warning (parameter 33.23 On-time 2 source).

cauza: Warning generated by edge counter 1.
remediu: Check the source of the warning (parameter 33.33 Edge counter 1 source).

cauza: Warning generated by edge counter 2.
remediu: Check the source of the warning (parameter 33.43 Edge counter 2 source).

cauza: Warning generated by value counter 1.
remediu: Check the source of the warning (parameter 33.53 Value counter 1 source).

cauza: Warning generated by an ontime timer. Programmable warnings: 33.14 On-time 1 warn message 33.24 On-time 2 warn message
remediu: Check the auxiliary code. Check the source of the warning corresponding to the code: 0: 33.13 On-time 1 source 1: 33.23 On-time 2 source 10: 5.4 Main fan on-time counter.

cauza: Warning generated by an ontime timer. Programmable warnings: 33.14 On-time 1 warn message 33.24 On-time 2 warn message
remediu: Check the auxiliary code. Check the source of the warning corresponding to the code: 0: 33.13 On-time 1 source 1: 33.23 On-time 2 source 10: 5.4 Main fan on-time counter.
