remediu: Check the auxiliary code. Check the source of the warning corresponding to the code: 0: 33.13 On-time 1 source 1: 33.23 On-time 2 source 10: 5.4 Main fan on-time counter.

cauza: Warning generated by an ontime timer. Programmable warnings: 33.14 On-time 1 warn message 33.24 On-time 2 warn message
remediu: Check the auxiliary code. Check the source of the warning corresponding to the code: 0: 33.13 On-time 1 source 1: 33.23 On-time 2 source 10: 5.4 Main fan on-time counter.

cauza: An analog signal is outside the limits specified for the analog input.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code (format XYY). “X” specifies the location of the input (0: AI on control unit; 1: I/O extension module 1, etc.), “YY” specifies the input and limit (01: AI1 under minimum, 02: AI1 over maximum, 03: AI2 under minimum, 04: AI2 over maximum). Check signal level at the analog input. Check the wiring connected to the input. Check the minimum and maximum limits of the input in parameter group 12 Standard AI, 14 I/O extension module 1, 15 I/O extension module 2 or 16 I/O extension module 3.

cauza: Warning generated by the signal supervision 1 function.
remediu: Check the source of the warning (parameter 32.7 Supervision 1 signal).

cauza: Warning generated by the signal supervision 2 function.
remediu: Check the source of the warning (parameter 32.17 Supervision 2 signal).

cauza: Warning generated by the signal supervision 3 function.
remediu: Check the source of the warning (parameter 32.27 Supervision 3 signal).

cauza: Selected signal has exceeded the user overload curve.
remediu: Check for any operating conditions increasing the monitored signal (for example, the loading of the motor if the torque or current is being monitored). Check the definition of the load curve (parameter group 37 User load curve).

cauza: Selected signal has fallen below the user underload curve.
remediu: Check for any operating conditions decreasing the monitored signal (for example, loss of load if the torque or current is being monitored). Check the definition of the load curve (parameter group 37 User load curve).

cauza: A cooling fan has reached the end of its estimated lifetime. See parameters 5.41 and 5.42.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code. The code indicates which fan is to be replaced. 0: Main cooling fan 1: Auxiliary cooling fan 2: Auxiliary cooling fan 2 3: Cabinet cooling fan 4: PCB compartment fan Refer to the hardware manual of the drive for fan replacement instructions.

cauza: Fault in external device 1.
remediu: Check the external device. Check setting of parameter 31.1 External event 1 source.

cauza: Fault in external device 2.
remediu: Check the external device. Check setting of parameter 31.3 External event 2 source.

cauza: Fault in external device 3.
remediu: Check the external device. Check setting of parameter 31.5 External event 3 source.

cauza: Fault in external device 4.
remediu: Check the external device. Check setting of parameter 31.7 External event 4 source.

cauza: Fault in external device 5.
remediu: Check the external device. Check setting of parameter 31.9 External event 5 source.

cauza: DDCS (fiber optic) communication between converters (for example, the inverter unit and the supply unit) is lost. Note that the inverter unit will continue operating based on the status information that was last received from the other converter.
remediu: Check status of other converter (parameters 6.36 and 6.39 Internal state machine LSU CW). Check settings of parameter group 60 DDCS communication. Check the corresponding settings in the control program of the other converter. Check cable connections. If necessary, replace cables.

cauza: The supply unit (or other converter) has generated a warning.
remediu: The auxiliary code specifies the original warning code in the supply unit control program. See section Auxiliary codes for line-side converter warnings (page 622).

cauza: The drive is entering sleep mode.
remediu: Informative warning. See section Process PID control, and parameters 40.41...40.48.

cauza: The speed controller autotune routine did not complete successfully.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code (format XXXX YYYY). “YYYY” indicates the problem (see actions for each code below).

aux_codes.cauza: The drive was stopped before the autotune routine finished.
aux_codes.remediu: Repeat autotune until successful.

aux_codes.cauza: The drive was started but was not ready to follow the autotune command.
aux_codes.remediu: Make sure the prerequisites of the autotune run are fulfilled. See section Speed controller autotune (page 48).

aux_codes.cauza: Required torque reference could not be reached before the drive reached maximum speed.
aux_codes.remediu: Decrease torque step (parameter 25.38) or increase speed step (25.39).

aux_codes.cauza: Motor could not accelerate/decelerate to maximum/minimum speed.
aux_codes.remediu: Increase torque step (parameter 25.38) or decrease speed step (25.39).

aux_codes.cauza: Motor could not decelerate with full autotune torque.
aux_codes.remediu: Decrease torque step (parameter 25.38) or speed step (25.39), or increase torque limits depending on limit source indicated in parameters 30.1 and 30.2.

cauza: A fault is about to be autoreset.
remediu: Informative warning. See the settings in parameter group 31 Fault functions.

cauza: Drive has received an emergency stop (mode selection off2) command.
remediu: Check that it is safe to continue operation. Reset the source of the emergency stop signal (such as an emergency stop push button). Restart drive. If the emergency stop was unintentional, check the source of the stop signal (for example, 21.5 Emergency stop source, or control word received from an external control system). (Off2) command to the follower(s). The Off2 stop is stored in the event log of the follower.

cauza: Drive has received an emergency stop (mode selection Off1 or Off3) command.
remediu: Check that it is safe to continue operation. Reset the source of the emergency stop signal (such as an emergency stop push button). Restart drive. If the emergency stop was unintentional, check the source of the stop signal (for example, 21.5 Emergency stop source, or control word received from an external control system).

cauza: A follower drive has tripped.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code. Add 2 to the code to find out the node address of the faulted drive. Correct the fault in the follower drive.

cauza: No enable start signal received.
remediu: Check the setting of (and the source selected by) parameter 20.19 Enable start command.

cauza: No run enable signal is received.
remediu: Check setting of parameter 20.12 Run enable 1 source. Switch signal on (e.g. in the fieldbus Control Word) or check wiring of selected source.

cauza: 95.4 Control board supply is set to External 24V but no voltage is connected to the XPOW connector of the control unit.
remediu: Check the external 24 V DC power supply to the control unit, or change the setting of parameter 95.4.

cauza: Motor ID run will occur at next start, or is in progress.
remediu: Informative warning.

cauza: Autophasing will occur at next start.
remediu: Informative warning.

cauza: Safe torque off function is active, i.e. safety circuit signal(s) connected to connector XSTO is lost.
remediu: Check safety circuit connections. For more information, see appropriate drive hardware manual and description of parameter 31.22 STO indication run/stop.

cauza: The drive has been powered up.
remediu: Informative event.

cauza: ID run completed.
remediu: Informative event. The auxiliary code specifies the type of ID run. 0: None 1: Normal 2: Reduced 3: Standstill 4: Autophasing 5: Current measurement calibration 6: Advanced 7: Advanced standstill

cauza: SW internal malfunction.
remediu: Contact your local ABB representative, quoting the auxiliary code. If the Drive Composer tool is available, also create and send a ‘support package’ (see Drive composer manual for instructions).

cauza: The calculated parameter checksum does not match any enabled reference checksum.
remediu: See A686 Checksum mismatch (page 603).

cauza: Software collects the information.
remediu: Informative event.

cauza: Safe torque off function is active, ie. STO circuit 1 is broken.
remediu: Check safety circuit connections. For more information, see appropriate drive hardware manual and description of parameter 31.22 STO indication run/stop (page 353). Check the auxiliary code, The code contains location information, especially with parallel-connected inverter modules. When converted into a 32-bit binary number, the bits of the code indicate the following: 31...28: Number of faulty inverter module (0...11 decimal). 1111: STO_ACT states of control unit and inverter modules in conflict 27: STO_ACT state of inverter modules 26: STO_ACT state of control unit 25: STO1 of control unit 24: STO2 of control unit 23...12: STO1 of inverter modules 12...1 (Bits of non-existing modules set to 1) 11...0: STO2 of inverter modules 12...1 (Bits of non-existing modules set to 1)

cauza: Safe torque off function is active, ie. STO circuit 2 is broken.
remediu: Check safety circuit connections. For more information, see appropriate drive hardware manual and description of parameter 31.22 STO indication run/stop (page 353). Check the auxiliary code, The code contains location information, especially with parallel-connected inverter modules. When converted into a 32-bit binary number, the bits of the code indicate the following: 31...28: Number of faulty inverter module (0...11 decimal). 1111: STO_ACT states of control unit and inverter modules in conflict 27: STO_ACT state of inverter modules 26: STO_ACT state of control unit 25: STO1 of control unit 24: STO2 of control unit 23...12: STO1 of inverter modules 12...1 (Bits of non-existing modules set to 1) 11...0: STO2 of inverter modules 12...1 (Bits of non-existing modules set to 1)

cauza: SW internal malfunction.
remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: No memory unit is attached to the control unit. The memory unit attached to the control unit is empty.
remediu: Power down the control unit. Check that the memory unit is properly inserted into the control unit. Power down the control unit. Attach a memory unit (with the appropriate firmware) to the control unit.

cauza: The memory unit attached to the control unit is incompatible.
remediu: Power down the control unit. Attach a compatible memory unit.

cauza: The firmware on the attached memory unit is incompatible with the drive.
remediu: Power down the control unit. Attach a memory unit with compatible firmware.

cauza: The memory unit is empty, or contains incompatible or corrupted firmware.
remediu: Recycle the power to the control unit. Check the sticker on the memory unit to confirm that the firmware is compatible with the control unit (ZCU-1x/BCU-x2). Connect Drive Composer PC tool (version 2.3 or later) to the drive. Select Tools - Recover drive. If the problem persists, replace the memory unit.

cauza: Motor ID run was not completed successfully.
remediu: Check the nominal motor values in parameter group 99 Motor data. Check that no external control system is connected to the drive. Cycle the power to the drive (and its control unit, if powered separately). Check that the motor shaft is not locked. Check the auxiliary code. The second number of the code indicates the problem (see actions for each code below).

aux_codes.cauza: Maximum current limit too low.
aux_codes.remediu: Check settings of parameters 99.6 Motor nominal current and 30.17 Maximum current. Make sure that 30.17 Maximum current > 99.6 Motor nominal current. Check that the drive is dimensioned correctly according to the motor.

aux_codes.cauza: Maximum speed limit or calculated field weakening point too low.
aux_codes.remediu: Check settings of parameters • 30.11 Minimum speed • 30.12 Maximum speed • 99.7 Motor nominal voltage • 99.8 Motor nominal frequency • 99.9 Motor nominal speed. Make sure that • 30.12 Maximum speed > (0.55 × 99.9 Motor nominal speed) > (0.50 × synchronous speed) • 30.11 Minimum speed < 0, and • supply voltage > (0.66 × 99.7 Motor nominal voltage).

aux_codes.cauza: Maximum torque limit too low.
aux_codes.remediu: Check settings of parameter 99.12 Motor nominal torque, and the torque limits in group 30 Limits. Make sure that the maximum torque limit in force is greater than 100%.

aux_codes.cauza: Current measurement calibration did not finish within reasonable time.
aux_codes.remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

aux_codes.cauza: Internal error.
aux_codes.remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

aux_codes.cauza: (Asynchronous motors only) Acceleration did not finish within reasonable time.
aux_codes.remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

aux_codes.cauza: (Asynchronous motors only) Deceleration did not finish within reasonable time.
aux_codes.remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

aux_codes.cauza: (Asynchronous motors only) Speed dropped to zero during ID run.
aux_codes.remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

aux_codes.cauza: (Permanent magnet motors only) First acceleration did not finish within reasonable time.
aux_codes.remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

aux_codes.cauza: (Permanent magnet motors only) Second acceleration did not finish within reasonable time.
aux_codes.remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

aux_codes.cauza: Internal error.
aux_codes.remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

aux_codes.cauza: (SynRM only) Rotor orientation not correct during the pulse test.
aux_codes.remediu: Try to perform ID run again. Contact your local ABB representative.

aux_codes.cauza: Not possible to perform Advanced Standstill ID run.
aux_codes.remediu: Check that nominal power is as advised in Advanced Standstill ID run description. Contact your local ABB representative.

aux_codes.cauza: (Asynchronous motors only) Error in motor data.
aux_codes.remediu: Check name plate data. Contact your local ABB representative.

aux_codes.cauza: Acceleration did not finish within reasonable time during Autophasing ID run.
aux_codes.remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

aux_codes.cauza: Advanced standstill failure.
aux_codes.remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

aux_codes.cauza: Rs estimation failure.
aux_codes.remediu: Check cabling. Check that switching frequency is high enough. Check sine filter settings if connected. Contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: A follower drive has tripped.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code. Add 2 to the code to find out the node address of the faulted drive. Correct the fault in the follower drive.

cauza: A fault trip command has been received through fieldbus adapter A.
remediu: Check the fault information provided by the PLC.

cauza: A fault trip command has been received through fieldbus adapter B.
remediu: Check the fault information provided by the PLC.

cauza: A fault trip command has been received through the embedded fieldbus interface.
remediu: Check the fault information provided by the Modbus controller.

cauza: Output current has exceeded internal fault limit.
remediu: Check supply voltage. Check that there are no power factor correction capacitors or surge absorbers in supply cable. Check motor load and acceleration times. Check power semiconductors (IGBTs) and current transducers.

cauza: IGBT supply has detected load unbalance.
remediu: Check AC fuses. Check for earth leakages. Check supply cabling. Check power modules. Check there are no power factor correction capacitors or surge absorbers in supply cable.

cauza: Excessive IGBT junction to case temperature.
remediu: Check supply cable.

cauza: Current difference detected by the branching unit (BU).
remediu: Check converter fuses. Check converter(s). Check inverter(s). Check LCL filter.

cauza: Earth leakage detected by the branching unit: sum of all currents exceeds the level.
remediu: Check AC fuses. Check for earth leakages. Check supply cabling. Check power modules. Check there are no power factor correction capacitors or surge absorbers in supply cable.

cauza: Excessive intermediate circuit DC voltage. Note: This warning can be shown only when the IGBT supply unit is not modulating.
remediu: Check that parameter 95.1 Supply voltage is set according to the supply voltage in use.

cauza: Intermediate circuit DC voltage is not sufficient due to missing phase in supply voltage, blown fuse or rectifier bridge internal fault. Note: This warning can be shown only when the IGBT supply unit is not modulating.
remediu: Check supply and fuses. Check that parameter 95.1 Supply voltage is set according to the supply voltage in use.

cauza: The voltage of the intermediate DC circuit has not yet risen to operating level. One input phase could be disconnected. Note: This warning can be shown only when the IGBT supply unit is not modulating.
remediu: Check the input voltage setting in parameter 95.1 Supply voltage. Check the input voltage. Check charging resistors. If the problem persists, contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: DC link voltage difference detected by the branching unit.
remediu: Check DC fuses. Check converter module connections to DC link.

cauza: Main voltage difference detected by the branching unit.
remediu: Check AC fuses. Check supply cable.

cauza: Power unit module temperature is excessive.
remediu: Check ambient conditions. Check air flow and fan operation. Check heatsink fins for dust pick-up. Check motor power against IGBT supply unit power.

cauza: High temperature difference between the IGBTs of different phases.
remediu: Check the cabling. Check cooling of power module(s).

cauza: IGBT temperature is excessive.
remediu: Check ambient conditions. Check air flow and fan operation. Check heatsink fins for dust pick-up. Check motor power against IGBT supply unit power.

cauza: The supply voltage range has not been defined.
remediu: Define the supply voltage range (parameter 95.1 Supply voltage).

cauza: Supply unit has received an emergency stop (mode selection off2) command.
remediu: Check that it is safe to continue operation. Return emergency stop push button to normal position. Restart the drive.

cauza: Supply module temperature is excessive due to eg, module overload or fan failure.
remediu: Check module cooling air flow and fan operation. Check ambient temperature. If it exceeds 40 °C (104 °F), ensure that load current does not exceed derated load capacity. See appropriate hardware manual. Check inside of cabinet and heatsink of supply module for dust pick-up. Clean whenever necessary.

cauza: Cooling fan is stuck or disconnected.
remediu: Check the auxiliary code in the line-side converter program to identify the fan. Check fan operation and connection. Replace fan if faulty.

cauza: Net lost is detected.
remediu: Resynchronize the IGBT supply unit to the grid after net lost.

cauza: There are too many DC link charging attempts.
remediu: Two attempts in five minutes is allowed to prevent charging circuit overheating.

cauza: Output current has exceeded internal fault limit.
remediu: Check supply voltage. Check that there are no power factor correction capacitors or surge absorbers in supply cable. Check motor load and acceleration times. Check power semiconductors (IGBTs) and current transducers.

cauza: IGBT supply unit has detected short circuit.
remediu: Check supply cable. Check there are no power factor correction capacitors or surge absorbers in supply cable. After correcting the cause of the fault, reboot the control unit (using parameter 96.8 Control board boot or by cycling power.

cauza: Excessive IGBT junction to case temperature.
remediu: Check the load.

cauza: Current difference detected by the branching unit (BU).
remediu: Check converter fuses. Check converter(s). Check inverter(s). Check LCL filter. Power off all boards. If the fault persists, contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Earth leakage detected by the branching unit: sum of all currents exceeds the level.
remediu: Check AC fuses. Check for earth leakages. Check supply cabling. Check power modules. Check there are no power factor correction capacitors or surge absorbers in supply cable. If no earth fault can be detected, contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Excessive intermediate circuit DC voltage.
remediu: Check that parameter 95.1 Supply voltage is set according to the supply voltage in use.

cauza: Intermediate circuit DC voltage is not sufficient because of a missing supply phase or blown fuse.
remediu: Check supply cabling, fuses and switchgear. Check that parameter 95.1 Supply voltage is set according to the supply voltage in use.

cauza: Difference in DC voltages between parallel-connected supply modules.
remediu: Check the DC fuses. Check the connection to the DC bus. If the problem persists, contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Difference in main voltages between parallel-connected supply modules.
remediu: Check the supply network connections. Check the AC fuses. If the problem persists, contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: DC link voltage is not high enough after charging.
remediu: Check parameter 95.1 Supply voltage. Check supply voltage and fuses. Check the connection from the relay output to the charging contactor. Check that the DC voltage measuring circuit is working correctly.

cauza: Power module temperature is excessive.
remediu: Check ambient temperature. If it exceeds 40 °C (104 °F), ensure that load current does not exceed derated load capacity. See appropriate hardware manual. Check power module cooling air flow and fan operation. Check inside of cabinet and heatsink of power module for dust pick-up. Clean whenever necessary.

cauza: IGBT temperature is excessive.
remediu: Check ambient conditions. Check air flow and fan operation. Check heatsink fins for dust pick-up. Check motor power against IGBT supply unit power.

cauza: Power unit module temperature is excessive.
remediu: See AE14 Excess temperature (page 623).

cauza: High temperature difference between the IGBTs of different phases. The amount of available temperatures depends on the frame size.
remediu: See AE15 Excess temperature difference.

cauza: Overtemperature detected either in cabinet, LCL filter or auxiliary transformer.
remediu: Check the cooling of the cabinet, LCL filter and auxiliary transformer.

cauza: An auxiliary cooling fan is stuck or disconnected.
remediu: Check the fan operation and connection. Replace the fan if faulty.

cauza: The hardware of the supply unit does not match the information stored in the memory unit. This may occur eg, after a firmware update or memory unit replacement.
remediu: Cycle the power to the supply unit. If the control unit is externally powered, reboot the control unit (using parameter 96.108 LSU control board boot) or by cycling its power. If the problem persists, contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: Control program does not receive main contactor on (1) acknowledgement through digital input even control program has closed the contactor control circuit with relay output. Main contactor / main breaker is not functioning properly, or there is a loose / bad connection.
remediu: Check main contactor / main breaker control circuit wiring. Check the status of other switches connected to contactor control circuit. See the delivery-specific circuit diagrams. Check main contactor operating voltage level (should be 230 V). Check digital input DI3 connections. Check related 48V power supply and connected fans.

cauza: Synchronizationto supply network has failed.
remediu: Monitor possible network transients.

cauza: Rating ID load error.
remediu: Contact your local ABB representative.

cauza: There are two types of licenses being used in ACS880 drives: licenses that need to be found from the unit which allow the firmware to be executed, and licenses that prevent the firmware from running. The license is indicated by the value of the auxiliary code field. The license is Nxxxx, where xxxx is indicated by the 4-digit value of the auxiliary code field. 8201: A restrictive license is found from the unit. The firmware on this inverter unit cannot be executed because a Low harmonic license is found from the unit. This unit is meant to be used with IGBT supply control program (2Q) only.
remediu: Check the line-converter control program. Record the auxiliary codes of all active licensing faults and contact your product vendor for further instructions. This fault requires a reboot of the control unit either by switching the power off and on, or using parameter 96.108 LSU control board boot. 8201: Contact your product vendor for further instructions.

cauza: Macro file has a parameter defined in such a way that it cannot be written.
remediu: Check aux code for the exact parameter group and index. Check if the parameter exists in the drive. Check the parameter value from the macro file matches the parameter’s minimum and maximum limits. If the aux code is zero, a generic file error occurs. Contact your local ABB representative. Aux-code in hexadecimal format contains an 8-bit Group, 8-bit Index, and 16-bit error code.

cauza: Control panel or PC tool selected as active control location has ceased communicating.
remediu: Check PC tool or control panel connection. Check control panel connector. Replace control panel in mounting platform.

cauza: Net lost is detected. Duration of net lost is too long.
remediu: Resynchronize the IGBT supply unit to the grid after net lost.
